## Purpose
The frontend's own settings (Settings → Frontend & Design): defaults, a localStorage cache so reloads paint correctly, and `applyUiConfig`, which writes the accent, surface tone, radius, text scale, fonts and document title onto the document.

## Responsibilities
- **`UI_DEFAULTS`:**
  - UI_ACCENT "ember", UI_COLOR_MODE "dark", UI_SURFACE_TONE "neutral", UI_RADIUS "default";
  - UI_FONT_BODY "rubik", UI_FONT_DISPLAY "space-mono", UI_TEXT_SCALE "default";
  - UI_BACKGROUND_EFFECTS true;
  - UI_BRAND_TITLE "Agentic AI", UI_BRAND_SUBTITLE "Design Patterns", UI_DOCUMENT_TITLE "Agentic AI Design Patterns";
  - UI_SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED true;
  - UI_NAV_LAYOUT "" (JSON `{order, hidden}`);
  - UI_TOAST_POSITION "top-right";
  - UI_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS 420, UI_HEALTH_POLL_SECONDS 30, UI_HEALTH_PAGE_POLL_SECONDS 15.
- **Cache:** `ui-config-v1`. `effectiveUiConfig` is defaults ← cache ← server. `useUiConfig()` merges the cache only after mount, to avoid hydration mismatches. `useServerUi()`.
- **Option tables:**
  - **`ACCENTS`:** ember, indigo, violet, blue, cyan, emerald, amber, rose, as oklch base and end values with a hue (some use dark text);
  - **`TONES`:** neutral, warm, cool, midnight;
  - **`RADII`:** sharp 0.25, default 0.5, rounded 0.75, extra 1 rem;
  - **`SCALES`:** compact 94%, default 100%, comfortable 106%, large 112%;
  - **fonts:** body (rubik, inter, ibm-plex-sans, dm-sans, system) and mono (space-mono, jetbrains-mono, ibm-plex-mono), with Google font specs.
- **`applyUiConfig(cfg, theme)`:**
  - sets or removes CSS variables for a non-default accent (primary, ring, indigo, sidebar, accent, gradient, glow);
  - sets the tone surfaces, with separate light and dark formulas;
  - sets the radius and the root font size;
  - injects the Google Fonts `<link id="ui-font-link">` and a `<style id="ui-font-style">` override;
  - calls `applyTitle`.
- **`applyTitle(name, renames)`:** replaces the default product name and renamed page names in `document.title`. It is idempotent and never flips back and forth.

## Key elements
`UI_DEFAULTS`, `useUiConfig`, `applyUiConfig`, `applyTitle`, `effectiveUiConfig`, `writeUiCache`.

## Control flow
Hooks, plus imperative DOM writes.

## Data, state and side effects
- Inline styles on `<html>`.
- Injected link and style tags.
- localStorage.

## Configuration
The `UI_*` settings from `/api/settings/public`.

## Interactions
- **Uses:** `components/layout/nav-items.tabRenames`.
- **Used by:** the app config applier in the root and layout, the theme and the sidebar.

## Error handling and edge cases
- Unknown option values fall back to the defaults.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Tailwind inlines theme fonts into utilities,** so fonts are overridden with an `!important` stylesheet.
- **The default accent and tone leave the stylesheet untouched** by removing the inline overrides.
- **The defaults must match the backend registry.**

## How to rebuild this file
Copy the tables, then write the functions as described.

## Tests
None.
